lines.text: Leah rolled her ankle two miles from the car.
Her friend called for help, and they waited.
Within minutes of stopping, Leah started to shiver.
Here's the fix. Put on every dry layer and a hat.
Get off the cold ground, so sit on your pack.
Then climb into an emergency bivy.
It reflects your body heat back and blocks the wind.
Leah was still warm when the rescue team reached them.
Save this before your next winter hike.
